acceptance_rule: Original Linux qualification: completed matched full150 evaluations with actual sampler/runtime attestation, zero runaways/CUDA faults, and accepted paired case review. Historical129/133 was not a fixed count threshold.

case_review.first_attempt_loss_review: Sorting the largest files, creating totals.csv, and preserving the GHCR skill failed first attempts but recovered within the prescribed three attempts. Candidate-only first passes TC-05 and CLI-19 are retained; net difference is one case.
case_review.third_attempt_loss_review: DE-14 fails strict multilingual name/array extraction. RM-06 returns mathematically correct3/4 and1/4 but uses noncanonical final-line keys; the original verifier rejects it. No score is regraded. Windows-only third-attempt passes HA-17 and HA-19 balance the two losses.
case_review.historical_loss_review: Archive-byte preservation, cron creation, and exact answer formatting remain model/agent behavior failures. All attempt traces remain retained. Other first-attempt losses recover on retries.
case_review.controlled_inference_evidence: RM-06 and RM-13 greedy and seed42 outputs, including reasoning, are byte-identical on Windows candidate, Windows CUDA130 control and Linux. This rules out a platform-specific difference in those controlled examples only.
case_review.decision: Accept the original paired-review gate for the stated model, sampler and32K quality protocol. Windows is one first-attempt case below the fresh Linux reference and equal atpass@3, and one case above the originalR9 baseline at both metrics. Valid thinking, identical150 definitions and actual samplers, zero runaways and no GPU/CUDA faults support this limited qualification.
case_review.limits: One unseeded full150 run per arm. McNemar p=1.0 for fresh comparisons is not proof of equivalence. Mixed wins/losses are preserved; do not claim broad or distributional quality equivalence.

extended81920_result.scope: Additional unseeded trial at frozen serving context, not the original32K quality gate. Retained and disclosed; no quality claim across all81K prompts is established.

earlier_adapter_error: Raw Windows receipts remain failed under the mistakenly added historical-score floor. This review supersedes that adapter verdict under the verified original gate; it does not erase or relabel measurements.
